name: Jori Halwin
source:
A spirit summoned by Raenelle, Jori has been stuck in the Living Realm since the inexplicable crisis occurred. 

Always smiling, joking around and making terrible puns, he seems unconcerned - and more thrilled than anything about his predicament. 

He now masquerades as a normal, living death mage, gleefully exploring the world and his newfound powers as a spirit.
